candidates.change_summary: Delete the line that updates acc.balance, so the user's balance is not increased by msg.value on Put.
Replace acc.balance update with acc.balance = msg.value, overwriting instead of adding.
Delete the nonReentrant_ modifier from Put, allowing reentrant calls that may change the observable result of a Put call.
Move LogFile.AddMessage before the acc.balance update; msg.value is still added but the event order changes, and if AddMessage reenters, the balance update happens afterward.
Replace acc.unlockTime update with acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime (ignoring block.timestamp floor), potentially setting a past unlock time.
Replace require(!locked_) with require(false), making nonReentrant_ always revert and preventing Put from ever succeeding.
Delete the locked_ = true assignment, breaking the reentrancy lock so nested calls under the same modifier succeed.
Insert an early return at the start of Put so successful calls become no-ops and callers see no state update.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function Put(uint _unlockTime) public nonReentrant_ payable { return; Holder storage acc = Acc[msg.sender]; acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value); acc.unlockTime = _unlockTime>block.timestamp?_unlockTime:block.timestamp; LogFile.AddMessage(msg.sender,msg.value,"Put"); }

candidates.change_summary: Delete the `require(!locked_);` statement in the nonReentrant_ modifier, allowing reentrant calls into Put.
candidates.mutated_unit_code: modifier nonReentrant_() { locked_ = true; _; locked_ = false; }

candidates.change_summary: Remove the condition `block.timestamp>acc.unlockTime` so funds become withdrawable before unlock time.
Remove the condition `acc.balance>=MinSum` so funds can be withdrawn even if balance is below MinSum.
Remove the condition `acc.balance>=_am` so Collect succeeds even for amounts larger than the user's balance (underflow reverts).
Delete the `require(!locked_);` statement in the nonReentrant modifier so reentrant calls are not blocked.
Delete the `locked_ = true;` statement in the nonReentrant modifier so reentrancy protection is never engaged.
Delete the `locked_ = false;` statement in the nonReentrant modifier so the contract remains locked forever after the first call.
Delete the nonReentrant_ modifier from Collect so reentrancy is no longer prevented while the external call is in progress.
Change the Collect guard from checking acc.balance >= MinSum to acc.balance > MinSum, altering which balances are collectable.
Change the Collect guard from checking acc.balance >= _am to acc.balance > _am, preventing exact-balance withdrawals.
Change the unlock-time guard from block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime to block.timestamp >= acc.unlockTime, allowing collection exactly at the unlock time.
Replace the conditional external call with an unconditional call that sends _am to msg.sender regardless of the callee's success flag.
Replace the balance subtraction with direct assignment to zero, so collecting any amount clears the entire balance after the external call returns.
Swap the value and label arguments in the Collect log message so history records the label as the amount and the amount as the label.
Move the balance subtraction to before the external call so reentrant observers see the reduced balance during the call.
Replace the nonReentrant_ require(!locked_) with require(locked_), inverting the guard so it blocks the normal case and permits the reentrant case.
Delete the locked_ = true statement so the reentrancy lock is never acquired.
Delete the locked_ = false statement so the lock is never released after the guarded function returns.
Removed the nonReentrant_ guard from Collect, allowing reentrant calls that can change Acc state for a chosen key during Collect.
Changed the Collect condition so it no longer requires the caller's own balance to meet MinSum, allowing state updates for any key.
Changed the Collect unlock-time check from greater-than to greater-than-or-equal, altering when the external call and state update execute.
Removed the nonReentrant_ modifier from Put, allowing reentrant calls that can change Acc under a caller-chosen key during an ongoing call.
Moved the balance update from before the LogFile external call to after it, changing what a reentrant LogFile observes and can do mid-call.
Moved the unlockTime update from before the LogFile external call to after it, changing what a reentrant LogFile observes and can do mid-call.
Removed the require(!locked_) guard from the nonReentrant_ modifier, effectively disabling the reentrancy lock.
